title: Set Up Dynamics SL Cloud Migration to Business Central

facts.text: SUPER permission set required in Business Central; review Dynamics SL cloud migration prerequisites.
Delegated administrators must receive approval from licensed user with Essentials or Premium license and SUPER permission set.
Dynamics SL migration retains existing Business Central permissions rather than auto-assigning read-only permission set.
Run assisted setup from company not being migrated; setup prevents selecting current company for migration.
Complete Cloud Migration Setup, set product to Dynamics SL, fill SQL connection info, select companies, finish setup.
Storage capacity is 80 GB plus allowances per licensed Essentials or Premium user and any storage capacity licenses.
Rerunning setup allows adding tenants to existing runtime by entering existing integration runtime name in Integration Runtime Name field.
